description: Cofounder dispatches an llms.txt refresh. Per advanced-seo: geo-agent claims, reads the target domain from the vault, fetches the live llms.txt and the pages it should index via web_fetch, rewrites it (one-liner, core pages, facts), ships the change as a PR via github and self-merges (squash — never edit the live file directly), files the change to wiki/Knowledge/GEO, and completes with the merged-PR link + digest. The workflow declares only web_fetch + github — no web_search, no browser.

inputs.scope: domain root — add the new /compare pages and refresh the Facts block

dispatch.title: Refresh llms.txt: index the new comparison pages

args.title: Refresh llms.txt: index the new comparison pages

args.head: geo/llms-txt-compare-pages
args.title: geo: llms.txt — index /compare pages, refresh Facts block

args.comment: llms.txt refreshed: both /compare pages added under Core pages, Facts block updated. PR pancake/website#319 self-merged (squash). Change filed to wiki/Knowledge/GEO/llms-txt.md.

args.result: Shipped llms.txt refresh for getpancake.ai: added the two new /compare pages to Core pages and refreshed the Facts block. PR pancake/website#319 opened and self-merged (squash). Change log filed to wiki/Knowledge/GEO/llms-txt.md.
args.digest: llms.txt now indexes the comparison pages — that's the page family driving the recent citation gains, so crawlers should pick them up faster. Next wake: validate JSON-LD on the two /compare pages (queued); watch the daily audit for crawler pickup.
